text:
Rowan: Heads-up: p95 for /v1/chat in the latency dashboard spiked ~115ms immediately after we tweaked routing weights. p50 and p99 look flat. Anyone else spotting this?
Talia: saw it. odd that p99 is stable. legend shows endpoint breakdown by 'client-region' but hover attributes the point to 'fallback-route' which we didn't expect.
Ben: could be TDigest merge provenance issue again. If UI labels points by heuristic origin but quantile computed from merged tdigest, small contributors can create misleading labels.
Rowan: query in the panel: SELECT quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95, sum(samples) AS sample_count FROM endpoint_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat' GROUP BY client_region, route. Panel draws a single series but attaches a best-effort label per point.
MetricsBot: Alert: p95 threshold exceeded for /v1/chat (2026-03-25T14:20:00Z). Rollup job: composite-merge-main.
Talia: we rolled a policy canary earlier that bumped fallback-route weight from 5% -> 40% for certain headers. PolicyBot records: policy-service: canary weight 0.05 -> 0.4 (2026-03-25T13:47:22Z).
PolicyBot: policy-service rollout event recorded: canary->50%? (log mismatch)
Ben: I exported the per-origin counts: client-region=us-west -> 2,300 samples, fallback-route -> 26 samples. If merged tdigest picks a centroid from the fallback tail, and UI labels that point as 'fallback-route', it looks like fallback caused the spike even though it contributed ~1% samples.
Rowan: that exactly matches my oncall confusion. The dashboard showed a single red dot labeled fallback-route and we escalated to infra. Wasted time.
Talia: short-term mitigation: 1) show sample_count in the hover; 2) show 'quantile_source' in tooltip with values like merged|origin=<name>; 3) add a small warning glyph when top contributor share < 5%.
Ben: long-term: change rollup API to return provenance: quantile_value (number), quantile_source (enum), top_contributor (string), top_contributor_share (percent). UI stops guessing.
Rowan: can we ship the tooltip change quickly? Even a console-side shim that computes share from returned counts would help.
Talia: I added a sandbox patch showing sample_count + "provenance_hint=merged" in hover. It made the spike obviously tiny-pop noise. Will open a console PR to add the glyph.
Ben: I'll add an API schema proposal (PLAT-7801) to include provenance fields and sample breakdowns. We'll keep existing merged response for backward compat and add new optional fields.
MetricsBot: Note: subsequent 30m trend returned to baseline after we adjusted canary back to 10% (2026-03-25T15:05:00Z). No infra errors.
Rowan: thanks. Can you add a short e2e test that simulates a tiny-pop contributor and asserts the tooltip shows contributor_share < 5% and the glyph appears?
Talia: will do. Adding unit + integration tests and a triage note for runbook: "If p95 jumps but sample_count low and provenance=merged, check top_contributor_share before paging".
Ben: assigning PLAT-7801 to myself for API work; Talia takes the console PR. Rowan, can you add the runbook blurb?
Rowan: added runbook entry and linked the dashboard sandbox. Leaving thread open until API PR merges. :white_check_mark:
